score: max_k mean softmax over members (higher = more confident)

implementation.ecdf: §5.5 option, linear interpolation: at each distinct val value u, Φ(u) = (#{v < u} + #{v ≤ u}) / (2·n_val) (average rank for ties, §5.4); np.interp between consecutive distinct val values; 0 below and 1 above the val range; same rule for Φ_S, Φ_M and every Φ_method of §7.6; S = MSP at T = 1. On val values Φ equals the step ECDF exactly, so α* is unaffected
implementation.gate_exact: R_α with α = i/20 computed as (i·L_S + (20−i)·L_M) / (40·n_val) from L = 2·n_val·Φ (integer at val values) in one division, so on val mathematically equal scores are equal in float64 (exact tie blocks for §7.1); R_1 = Φ_S and R_0 = Φ_M bit-for-bit
implementation.alpha: C-AURC (§7.1) on the val fold, Φ_S/Φ_M fitted on the same val fold; 21 values; val C-AURC within 1e-12 of the minimum is a tie -> largest α (closest to softmax only); full val curve saved
implementation.temperature: β = 1/T minimises mean NLL on val (convex in β); scipy bounded Brent on β ∈ [0.01, 100], xatol 1e-10; guard: β not at a bound and |dNLL/dβ| < 1e-6; TS score = MSP(logits/T*); prediction unchanged (argmax is invariant to T > 0)
implementation.tau: accept iff score ≥ τ; τ = k-th largest val score, k = ⌈c*·n_val⌉ in integer arithmetic -> the smallest val coverage ≥ c*; same rule for every method
implementation.phi_method: §7.6: the ECDF rule above, fitted on val for every method's final score incl. R_α*; applied to every patch here, 06 uses the test rows
implementation.slots: slots 1-11 get identical fits (ablation slots 10-11 feed AURC_1 of §9.2/§9.3); Deep Ensembles (§6.4): slot 1 + slots 6-9, score = max_k of the mean softmax (Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017), prediction = argmax of the mean softmax, no TS, no Φ (round 1 only, outside §7.6), τ as above
